questions.text: According to KDIGO guidelines, Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is formally defined by which diagnostic criteria?

options.C: Asymptomatic microscopic hematuria persisting for more than 7 days
options.D: Complete bilateral anuria present for at least 24 hours
options.E: Unilateral hydronephrosis with normal contralateral GFR
